ruleDefinitions.name: Wget Creating Files in Tmp Directory
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of wget to download content in a temporary directory such as "/tmp" or "/var/tmp"

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\/wget$") AND (file_path = RGX("^\\/tmp\\/") OR file_path = RGX("^\\/var\\/tmp\\/")))
